target.title: Wire workspace admin controls
target.body:
## Summary
- Add workspace admin API support for updating name, slug, and icon, transferring ownership, and deleting a workspace.
- Persist `workspace.icon_url` through SQLite/Postgres migrations, schemas, store adapters, and API responses.
- Make workspace icon uploads visible to all members of the same workspace without broadening access to unrelated unattached uploads.
- Delete configured upload storage objects when a workspace is deleted.
- Serialize Postgres ownership transfer role reads with `FOR UPDATE` and use regenerated sqlc query helpers for workspace mutations.
- Wire the workspace settings overview UI plus workspace rail/sidebar icon rendering, including an accessible rail link label.
- Make the TypeScript SDK build script work on Windows by replacing POSIX-only shell commands with a Node copy script.

## Proof
- `pnpm generate:sqlc`
- `go test ./apps/api/internal/httpapi -run TestWorkspaceAdminHTTPUploadLifecycle -count=1 -v`
- `go test ./apps/api/internal/store/sqlite -run TestWorkspaceIconMigrationUpgradesExistingData -count=1 -v`
- `go test ./apps/api/internal/store/postgres -run TestWorkspaceIconMigrationUpgradesExistingData -count=1 -v` (skips locally without `CLICKCLACK_POSTGRES_TEST_DSN`; test is present for Postgres-backed runs)
- `go test ./apps/api/internal/httpapi ./apps/api/internal/store/sqlite ./apps/api/internal/store/postgres`
- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm --filter @clickclack/web typecheck`
- `pnpm build`

External proof artifact: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Solvely-Colin/pr-proof-assets/56e53d20dc5d6a64f2af4c45ad1367c818e2f0d4/clickclack/workspace-admin-controls/workspace-admin-lifecycle-proof.md

## Screenshot
![Workspace icon proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Solvely-Colin/pr-proof-assets/34875f5c494d3250f83f7a29a38f4c4e1b28aaa3/clickclack/workspace-admin-controls/workspace-icon-proof.png)
